set.body:
From the S4.2 hover-flake fix (s42-hover-flake 0fba0f1) and its review. FX test stages are real OS windows; the physical pointer's MOUSE_ENTERED/MOVED/EXITED reach them (e.g. when another window closes and uncovers the stage) and change hover state between synthetic events. InputAdapterFxSuite now consumes mouse events it did not fire; other suites firing synthetic mouse events are exposed the same way.

Acceptance: StudioRobot owns a 'firing' flag and FxStage installs a scene filter that consumes and counts foreign mouse events, opt-out per suite (for tests of real :hover behaviour); every direct Event.fireEvent of mouse events in the FX suites routes through the robot; consumed counts appear in receipts/logs; popups/context menus (other windows) documented as uncovered; InputAdapterFxSuite drops its local filter.
set.title: Studio FX harness: consume OS pointer events not fired by the test robot, suite-wide
